description.en: Loads and runs the fixed shop event script (data/script/event/ev43020000.nutb), passing it the given event ID and NPC handle, then drives its Event coroutine to completion frame by frame. Used for NPCs that open a shop when talked to.
Event ID passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.id.
NPC handle passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.npc_hdl.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
